verdict.rationale: Hightouch docs say marketers can build audiences in a no-code UI once the schema is configured. Customer Studio is described as the self-serve interface for building audiences and exploring segments, and builds traits and audiences on top of resolved identities and collected events. A company statement on HN also cites a business-user UI for visual audience filtering. Nothing in the pack shows an estimated audience size or preview count before activation, and behavioral conditions in the builder appear only by implication. Missing for 10: evidence of audience size estimation or preview before activation, explicit docs on behavioral/event conditions in the visual builder, independent hands-on corroboration of the no-SQL builder.
